subject: Request to expand demo — include CloudOps/Platform + procurement (split slots)?
messages:
From: Claire Benson <claire@aderahealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@cloudops.io>, procure@aderahealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — additional stakeholders to include

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team found the throughput/cost numbers really compelling. A quick heads-up: Governance asked us to include Platform, CloudOps, Security, and Procurement in the next runthrough before we proceed with a POC.

Can we expand the session to make sure those teams can attend? A couple of constraints:
- Tom (CloudOps) is mostly remote the week of 6/18–6/20 and has limited blocks.
- Security needs a 45-minute window where they can see the KV caching and isolation story.
- Procurement wants a short 20–30 minute commercial + contract Q&A.

We can be flexible on format — if it helps, we can split into a technical deep-dive + a commercial slot. What would you recommend?

Also looping in procure@aderahealth.com to coordinate the buying questions.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Benson
Head of Product, Adera Health
claire@aderahealth.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Claire Benson <claire@aderahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — additional stakeholders to include

Hi Claire — really glad the team found the numbers useful. Splitting into two focused slots is a good approach and what we typically do when procurement + security want different depth. Quick proposal:

Option A (same day split):
- 09:00–09:45 PT: Technical deep-dive (Platform, CloudOps, Security) — demos of deployment, KV caching, and isolation patterns
- 10:15–10:45 PT: Commercial + procurement Q&A (pricing, SSO/KMS, timelines)

Option B (split-day):
- Day 1: Tech deep-dive (45m)
- Day 2: Commercial + procurement (30m)

I can host the technical session with one of our infra engineers and Marissa will cover procurement/contract flow. Vivek will join for security and isolation details if available.

What dates/times do Tom and procurement have? Happy to draft calendar invites once we lock availability.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com
From: Claire Benson <claire@aderahealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@cloudops.io>, procure@aderahealth.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — additional stakeholders to include

Thanks Mateo — quick update from the group:
- Procurement can do a focused slot but is only available on 2028-06-19 after 11:00 PT or 2028-06-22 after 09:30 PT.
- Security can do 2028-06-21 between 08:30–12:00 PT but prefers a single 45-min contiguous block.
- Tom (CloudOps) is traveling 6/19–6/20 but can stretch for a 9:00–10:00 PT window on 6/21.

Given that, we were thinking: two-part runthrough on 6/21 where CloudOps + Security do the morning technical block and procurement joins a follow-up later that week (6/22) for the commercial Q&A. I attached a procurement checklist so you know what they'll want covered.

Attached: procurement-checklist.xlsx

Could you confirm whether a 6/21 tech deep-dive (45m) + 6/22 procurement slot (30m) works on your side?

— Claire
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Claire Benson <claire@aderahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — additional stakeholders to include

On Wed, 13 Jun 2028 at 08:45, Claire Benson <claire@aderahealth.com> wrote:
> Given that, we were thinking: two-part runthrough on 6/21 where CloudOps + Security do the morning technical block and procurement joins a follow-up later that week (6/22) for the commercial Q&A.

That plan works for us. Proposed invites below — I kept the technical slot a bit longer to make room for live troubleshooting and a short Q&A:

- Technical deep-dive: 2028-06-21 09:00–09:50 PT (Platform, CloudOps, Security) — host: Mateo + Vivek; include runbook and KV cache demo
- Commercial + procurement: 2028-06-22 10:00–10:30 PT — host: Marissa; include pricing sensitivity and contract timeline

I'll send calendar invites and attach an agenda for each session. Also attaching an internal runbook excerpt we can share with Security during the technical session.

Attachments: extended-demo-agenda.pdf

Can everyone confirm availability? If Procurement needs an earlier slot on 6/22, say 09:30, we can adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Mateo
From: Claire Benson <claire@aderahealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@cloudops.io>, procure@aderahealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 16:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — additional stakeholders to include

Perfect — confirmed on our side.

- 2028-06-21 09:00–09:50 PT: CloudOps + Security in for the technical deep-dive
- 2028-06-22 10:00–10:30 PT: Procurement will join for the commercial Q&A (procure@aderahealth.com)

We'll expect the agenda and calendar invites. Thanks for accommodating the split — should make both sessions higher signal.

Best,
Claire
